summary: R0 needs a recorded starting state per ship and the game version it was observed on. This adds the file format only; the --baseline command and summary table are a later slice.  sdk/state/baseline.py writes one AccountSnapshot as stable JSON (<alias>-<UTC time>.json) holding the alias, UTC observation time, game version and every snapshot section, with unobserved sections null and each section's completeness recorded (S04-R2). Files are created exclusively, so a second write for the same alias and second is refused (S04-R4). load_baseline returns a snapshot equal to the one written, so diff_snapshots can compare a later snapshot with it (S04-R5).  Nothing is written or loaded that fails the secret scan: the sdk.redaction patterns plus a numeric id in a UserId/Id field, the S03-R2 capture rules, implemented locally so this slice does not depend on SPEC-03 code. JSON files are also scanned per decoded string, because JSON escaping hides quoted patterns such as "DeviceKey":"..." from the raw-text scan. scan_baseline_directory applies the same rules to docs/experiments/baselines/ (S04-R7). The game_identity fingerprint is kept; a raw user id is refused. Implemented by the SPEC-04 builder specialist subagent in an isolated worktree, independently reviewed by the verifier subagent (tests cite its requirement ids; parent re-validated in a scratch clone), and re-validated by the parent.
